verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developers.cloudflare.com, which hosts the Registrar docs. Registrar pages are also served as markdown (an index.md URL is cited), and an agent-setup page covers agent onboarding. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt includes Registrar-specific content, a working markdown variant at the /registrar/.md path (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
